root_text:
Here's some positive news!  
HMPV (Human Metapneumovirus) is:
- very common
- symptoms like a mild cold
- only lasts a few days

In short, no big deal.  Certainly nothing to take a "vaccine" (bioweapon) injection for.

https://t.co/gYXsA6Lf
